name: Lucena (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Lucena (a star and a castle on blue and red, with a laurel wreath).
history: Municipal flag of Lucena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Lucena arms — star and castle with a laurel wreath
